theorems.name: Submission.dorag_dbs_mult_eq_one_of_density_lt_two
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W S : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (c₀ : ℝ), 0 < n → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → S ⊆ W → c₀ < 2 → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), R.measure (closedBall x t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c₀ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ S → R.mult x = 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
